title: Lowtinder - the Lantern Lullaby, drowned
_note: Tinderwick's theme (tinderwick-a) under forty years of sea. The SAME melody note-for-note, slowed from 92 to 72 BPM and re-harmonised into A minor (Am-F-C-G under the old C-major tune, so the homely line turns wistful). First pass: the lead on a soft TRIANGLE (underwater, no pulse bite) over a slow string bed, a slow surf hiss, bell glints at phrase ends. Second pass: the lead falls silent and a MUSIC-BOX bell carries the melody an octave up, as if from an upstairs window (Gran Tallow's lamp), over a slow harp. snes era, chip render. 32-bar loop.
